_why: lane models-at-session (q-053 P0c): what a provider's own model list answers — the loopback fake of the refresh door serves these (no vendor call anywhere). `openrouter` = the OpenRouter /api/v1/models shape (name, context_length, architecture.input_modalities, supported_parameters); `openai` = the OpenAI-compatible /v1/models shape ({ data: [{ id, object, owned_by }] }, nothing else).
